docs.message:
docs(pdt42): learning engine (D6)

## Intent

Show how the platform helps each core role start, get better and catch new opportunities. Supply does not come by itself, so the engine has to make the first listing cheap and return use and praise to creators.

## Key changes

- A new D6 chapter holds the learning engine for creators, adopting adults and students, with generic services linked to stages, transactions and channels.
- Creators start with guidance for their AI assistant, list their first app almost without effort, learn how it is used, and build on other apps.
- Adults and students can evolve into creators. Creators can evolve into co-owners of the platform by contributing best practices to the guidance; D1 notes this path.
- Services are placed per role and stage: assembling apps for a class only for adults, finding apps before a test and starting an app right away for students. The students' portrait gains the potential to build their own app.
- The development plan marks D6 done and adds KD-16.

## Dependencies and side effects

- How creators become co-owners belongs to the governance in lernapps/.github.
